_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Donkey (Donkey 3, last pre-Donkey-5 generation) in MONO (single) mode. The Donkey is one convertible stroller that runs in mono (1 seat) or duo/twin (2 seats) mode; this file captures the mono configuration. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Donkey 3 Mono (single mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Donkey (Mono) | Bugaboo Donkey 2 Mono Adapter for Maxi-Cosi | 855190MC01 | *Positions 3-5 only (max 30 lb)

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo.com lists 30.64 lb for the Donkey 3 Mono complete configuration. Lightest chassis+wheels+seat config is ~27.6 lb and full (with baskets/canopy) ~32.4 lb per ANB Baby listing.
specs._unfoldedNote: Highest handlebar position per Bugaboo.com (lowest handlebar: 32.2 x 23.6 x 33.4 in). Mono width is 23.6 in; in DUO/TWIN mode the frame widens to 29.1 in (see bugaboo-donkey-twin).
specs._foldedNote: Compact two-piece fold per Bugaboo.com (35.04 x 23.62 x 13.78 in). A one-piece self-standing fold (26.4 x 23.6 x 34.3 in) is also available.

brake.type: foot-operated push-down/lift-up central pedal parking brake

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (with included bassinet or a car seat via adapter); ~0-4 years in seat

safety.standards: Sold in the US market (subject to CPSC 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833); Bugaboo does not publish a specific stroller-standard citation on the US product page.
safety.notes: 5-point adjustable harness; central foot brake; puncture-proof foam wheels with all-wheel suspension. Bugaboo does not advertise JPMA certification for the Donkey.

specs.foldType: two-piece compact fold (one-piece self-standing fold also available)
specs.recline: multi-position reclining seat (incl. full recline); reversible bassinet from birth
specs.tires: puncture-proof foam-filled wheels, 10 in front / 12 in rear, all-wheel suspension

notes: This is the Bugaboo Donkey 3 (the last generation before the 2023+ Donkey 5) in MONO (single) mode - one seat, 23.6 in wide. It is physically the SAME stroller as bugaboo-donkey-twin; three clicks convert it between mono (single) and duo/twin (side-by-side double) modes, so the twin file shares source pages and differs only in seatCount, width, weight and price. Clek Liing attaches via the Bugaboo Donkey Mono adapter for Maxi-Cosi (855190MC01 / adapter-855190mc01). CLEK CAVEAT: per Clek's official list the Liing is usable ONLY in Donkey handle positions 3-5, and on the Donkey 2 generation with a max 30 lb limit. The Donkey 3 is now largely discontinued/clearance; Bugaboo.com MSRP $1,399 (seen on sale ~$1,119); ANB Baby had a Mineral Mono at $900.99 but out of stock at check. Max child height is not published by Bugaboo (null).
